action: Install Microsoft's November 2026 security updates across Windows, Office, Exchange, SharePoint, SQL Server and developer tools, taking the fix for CVE-2026-124194 first. Use the MSRC release notes linked from the advisory to scope the work.
exec: Canada's agency confirms one flaw in this month's Microsoft release is exploited; the update belongs at the top of the patch queue.
plain: Canada's cyber agency passed on Microsoft's monthly security fixes and later added that one of the flaws is already being used by attackers. It covers Windows, Office, Exchange, SharePoint and many cloud services.

key_findings: The advisory covers Microsoft's November 2026 monthly rollup as of November 10 and was updated on November 12.
Products listed include Windows 10 and 11, Windows Server 2012 to 2025, Microsoft 365 Apps, Office LTSC, Exchange Server Subscription Edition, SharePoint Server and SQL Server 2017 to 2025.
Azure services listed include DevOps, Front Door, Machine Learning, Managed Grafana, Open AI, Privileged Identity Management and Virtual Machines.
CVE-2026-124194 is the only CVE named; the advisory relays Microsoft's indication that it has been exploited.
Update 1 records that CISA added CVE-2026-124194 to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on November 10.
recommendations: Review the November 2026 Security Updates on the MSRC release notes page.
Review the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities entry for CVE-2026-124194.
Apply the necessary updates as they become available.

summary: Cyber Centre advisory AV26-1142 relays Microsoft's November 2026 security updates to Canadian organisations. The affected list spans Windows 10 and 11, Windows Server 2012 to 2025, Microsoft 365 Apps and Office, Exchange Server Subscription Edition, SharePoint Server, SQL Server, .NET, Visual Studio and many Azure services. Update 1, dated November 12, adds that Microsoft reports CVE-2026-124194 as exploited and that CISA catalogued it on November 10.
title: Canadian Centre for Cyber Security: Microsoft November rollup AV26-1142 updated for exploited flaw CVE-2026-124194

validation.note: Reviewed against the original Canadian Centre for Cyber Security document.

date_note: Advisory issued November 10 and updated November 12 (Update 1 adds the exploited flaw).

review.note: Checked against the CCCS advisory: dates Nov 10/12, products, only CVE-2026-124194, KEV Nov 10 all match. Title said 'Outlook flaw' but the advisory names no product; removed. Added date_note for the old-date flag. Correction file added.
